description: Look up public property facts in Spain (inmuebles y Catastro de España) by cadastral reference: recorded use, area, construction year and reference coordinates when available.

defaultPrompt: Prepara una ficha catastral de 2749704YJ0624N0001DI con uso, superficie y año de construcción.
Look up Spanish property 2749704YJ0624N0001DI and cite the official cadastral facts.
Consulta las coordenadas de 2749704YJ0624N y distingue longitud, latitud y referencia de parcela.
interface.longDescription: Turn a cadastral reference into a clear property fact sheet for Spain (España). Look up public recorded use, built area, parcel area and construction year when available, plus a reference point labelled as EPSG:4326 longitude and latitude. Keep official source links and distinguish descriptive facts from coordinate-service results. The lookup does not search by street address, identify owners, certify title or boundaries, value property or confirm planning permission. Navarra and the Basque Country use separate cadastral systems.
